items.title: Arsenal Foundation donates to Nepal flood relief
items.blurb: The Premier League club says it will also pay tribute to flood victims before its Champions League match against Napoli this week.

items.title: Nepal races to rebuild roads and bridges washed away by floods
items.blurb: With 41 bridges destroyed between Rasuwa and Chitwan, authorities are reopening roads and seeking temporary bridges from China and India to restore key links.

items.title: How two men survived nine days in a Nepal flood tunnel
items.blurb: Trapped in an air pocket beneath the wreckage of a hydropower tunnel, two workers endured nine days of darkness, mud and dwindling hope before rescuers heard a faint sound from underground.

items.title: How crypto found a ‘legal’ route into Nepal’s relief efforts
items.blurb: A new US-based channel lets cryptocurrency users donate to Nepal’s disaster fund without the digital assets entering the country, where crypto trading and use are prohibited.

items.title: A flood of bad news leaves Nepal’s tourist hubs eerily quiet
items.blurb: Negative reports about the Bhotekoshi floods, road disruptions, and travel advisories have hit bookings in Pokhara, Chitwan and Lumbini just as the peak tourist season gets underway.

items.title: Democracy amid disaster: What kind of state do we need in a crisis?
items.blurb: A disaster grants rulers extraordinary power and authority, raising the question of whether they will use that power to protect citizens or restrict them.

items.title: 576 Nepalis stranded in China after Bhotekoshi floods repatriated
items.blurb: The citizens were brought back through the Kodari border crossing with assistance from China and coordination by Nepal’s Armed Police Force.

items.title: Nepal president appeals for climate justice after devastating floods
items.blurb: Ramchandra Paudel urges international action for vulnerable countries as Nepal mourns 1,355 deaths and continues the search for 4,996 people unaccounted for.

items.title: South Asian lawmakers call for stronger regional climate cooperation
items.blurb: Parliamentarians back proposals for a regional climate council, electricity grid and cross-border disaster-warning system after Nepal’s recent glacial-related disaster.

items.title: Nepal flood death toll rises to 1,355, nearly 5,000 unaccounted for
items.blurb: More than 21,000 security personnel remain deployed as rescue teams continue operations across eight flood-hit districts.

items.title: Nepali Army says 121 people may be trapped in flood-hit hydropower tunnels
items.blurb: About 900 people were initially reported unaccounted for at affected projects, but the army says only around 121 are believed to be inside tunnels.

items.title: 65 schools in Bidur to reopen on Wednesday after August 26 floods
items.blurb: Flood-affected children can attend any nearby school without uniforms as Bidur authorities work to restore classes after the Bhotekoshi disaster.

items.title: Families demand answers for missing hydropower workers
items.blurb: Relatives of workers missing after the Rasuwa floods say delays in the search are deepening their anguish as they demand a faster, better-equipped rescue effort.

items.title: Rubio calls Rabi Lamichhane, offers additional support after Bhotekoshi floods
items.blurb: US Secretary of State expresses condolences over loss of lives and says Washington is ready to provide additional assistance as Nepal continues search, rescue, and relief operations.

items.title: Arnold Dix says Nepal rescue teams face challenge unlike any before
items.blurb: The Australian tunnel expert, who arrived in Kathmandu on Saturday, joined Nepali and Indian teams searching for people believed to be trapped inside the Chilime hydropower tunnel.

items.title: Floods wash away 1,806 hectares of farmland, threaten food supplies
items.blurb: Bhotekoshi floods are expected to cut food production by 7,686 tonnes in affected areas.

items.title: Nepal moves against online abuse targeting flood survivors
items.blurb: Cyber Bureau forms 10-member team to identify users posting hateful and demeaning comments about people affected by the Bhotekoshi floods.

items.title: Mental wellbeing: How to help without feeling helpless after the floods
items.blurb: From donating and sharing useful information to taking a break from distressing coverage, small actions can help us move beyond helplessness.

items.title: People in flood-hit Rasuwa villages call for help after supplies run out
items.blurb: Residents of Aamachhodingmo Rural Municipality who have lost family members look up for help when they hear a helicopter fly. Their prayers mostly go unanswered.

items.title: Flood sends hydropower shares tumbling, but damage is uneven
items.blurb: The Bhotekoshi floods have hit a handful of listed hydropower projects, yet shares across the sector, and in insurance, have fallen as investors grapple with uncertainty over losses, claims and reconstruction.
